sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2022. Change Request Number 2022-013: retire [kgm] Karipúna (adopted 2023-01-20). Dallas: SIL International. 5 pp.
sources.note: Nothing on stress. p.2, sec. 3: reason for retirement 'There is no evidence that the language exists' / 'equivalent to.. Palikur [plu]'; rationale: 'The name Karipúna (Karipuna do Amapá) generally refers to a variant of Palikúr in earlier references (Gallois and Ricardo 1983). A short word list attests to the fact that Karipúna is a Palikúr variety (Loukotka 1963). Other more recent references refer to an immigrant group whose original language has not been verified, but has been reported to be Nhengatu [yrl].. sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page kari1309 'Karipúna do Amapá' (Hammarström et al.),https://glottolog.org/resource/languoid/id/kari1309
sources.note: Nothing; classifies the languoid as Bookkeeping (retired), ISO kgm retired as duplicate of Palikur [plu] per CR 2022-013; only overview/ethnographic references listed (Glottolog lists no grammar, sketch or phonology).

sources.citation: Loukotka, Čestmír. 1963. Documents et vocabulaires inédits de langues et de dialectes sud-américains. Journal de la Société des Américanistes 52: 7-60 (short 'Karipúna' word list identified as a Palikúr variety).
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: The only primary linguistic data ever attributed to 'Karipúna do Amapá'; a word list, so at most accent marks on forms, no stress statement expected. Relevant only to confirm the Palikúr identity (pali1279), which is already catalogued.

sources.citation: Glottolog reference list for kari1309 as printed in : Malcher 1953; Arnaud 1996; Tobler 1979/80 'Adivinhações Karipúna'; Grenand 1972; Tassinari 1998a,b
sources.tag: not read: abstract or record only
sources.note: Not opened; all are ethnographic/overview items (Tobler's riddles are in Karipúna French Creole = kari1301), none is a grammar or phonology of a distinct 'Karipuna do Amapá' language.
